fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Dade County grand jury practices and the state's attorney Vernon Hawthorne in connection with the acquittal of Senator Hayes Lewis, with discussion of gambling investigations and political implications. Also features extensive local nightlife and entertainment coverage and advertisements (clubs, shows, and venues), racing news and tips focused on Hialeah Park, and a Better Housing Program informational page about financing home repairs under the National Housing Act.
